newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks bounce back strongly.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks bounce back strongly.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks clawed back part of the previous day's big losses Thursday as investors focused on corporate earnings, which have been mostly upbeat so far in the second-quarter reporting period.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 44.33 points at 7,886.76 after Wednesday's 120-point loss.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 17-11 on heavy volume of 554 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
